title: D.N.A Workspace
description: Virtual walkthrough of D.N.A Workspace, Bandar Baru Bangi — co-working units and meeting facilities. Use the scene list or the pins to move between areas.

scenes.title: Glassbox #1
scenes.description: Open-plan co-working floor with rows of desks and monitors, curved black-framed glass boxes with lime-yellow frosted lower panels, a whiteboard on an easel, and daylight through blinds overlooking greenery.

scenes.title: Glassbox #2
scenes.description: Open-plan office with black-framed glass meeting boxes and lime-yellow frosted panels.

scenes.title: Meeting Room
scenes.description: Meeting room with a curved light-wood table and black metal chairs, grey concrete walls with a white mural, pendant lighting and a vertical window on the left.

scenes.title: Pantry
scenes.description: Pantry and break-out corner in a co-working office: wood-grain cabinet base with a small sink, microwave, open metal wall shelving, water dispenser and a tall locker unit. Black metal grid partitions separate it from the adjoining co-working area, lit by industrial pendant lights over light wood laminate flooring.

scenes.title: Hot Desk
scenes.description: Open-plan co-working floor: wooden flooring, exposed concrete walls and roller blinds, black-cable string pendant lights, diagonal blue-panelled workstations with wood tops and blue chairs, plus standard desks with monitors. Glass-walled meeting rooms and yellow accent walls beyond.
